title: chore(deps): bump lucide-react from 1.24.0 to 1.25.0
body:
Bumps [lucide-react](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/HEAD/packages/lucide-react) from 1.24.0 to 1.25.0.
Release notes

Sourced from lucide-react's releases.

Version 1.25.0

What's Changed

  • fix(icons): Rename to circle-euro to match other euro icons by @​ericfennis in lucide-icons/lucide#4531
  • chore(deps-dev): bump astro from 6.1.10 to 6.4.6 by @​dependabot[bot] in lucide-icons/lucide#4487
  • fix(site): empty search results on first load for tag-only matches by @​taimar in lucide-icons/lucide#4413
  • chore(deps-dev): bump @​babel/core from 7.28.5 to 7.29.6 by @​dependabot[bot] in lucide-icons/lucide#4476
  • fix(ci): broken link in brand logo comment by @​jguddas in lucide-icons/lucide#4533
  • chore(depedencies): Update dependencies by @​ericfennis in lucide-icons/lucide#4553
  • feat(docs): add studio link by @​jguddas in lucide-icons/lucide#4534
  • fix(icons): changed hdmi-port icon by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4554
  • fix(icons): changed ethernet-port icon by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4555
  • fix(icons): changed file-box icon by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4552
  • feat(icons): added scan-box icon by @​karsa-mistmere in lucide-icons/lucide#4551

Full Changelog: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/compare/1.24.0...1.25.0
